name: Exeaon Research Reproduction Benchmark (starter)
note: A fixed set of reproduction TASKS (Faraday/Replica-style): reproduce each `target` from its `paper` end-to-end and record the value with score_reproduction(name=<task id>, claimed=<your value>, reference=<task reference>). benchmark_report then aggregates matched/total into a benchmark score. EXTEND THIS with real, citable targets — each `reference` MUST be a number a source actually states (or that Exeaon has independently measured, noted in `provenance`). Do not invent reference values.

tasks.target: Extra lossless (rANS/entropy) compression gain on REAL group-128 AWQ int4 LLM weights
tasks.hint: Quantize a real model to per-group(128) zero-point int4 (or load an official AWQ checkpoint); measure the code histogram entropy H per tensor, parameter-weighted; gain = 4 / H (include scale/zero metadata for the end-to-end figure).
tasks.provenance: Measured in Exeaon's own reproduction run (2026-09-09) on Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-AWQ; brackets EntroLLM's ~1.05x and 2606.15789's 1.1-1.3x band. Replace with a paper-stated figure if reproducing a specific paper.
